body: CURRENT CHIEF STATE, 2026-08-31. Product target: admitted video edition plus recall transcript -> sparse, auditable GraphHsmm mapping with posterior P, transition flow F, faithful/distorted/external modes, exact time/text evidence, explicit Unranked/unresolved mass, typed bundle, and locally openable uncertainty report. Current main e584ad6 has the downstream engine: WorkedExampleSuite 24/24 and the narrow raw-source/recall vertical 1/1 pass. This is machinery proof, not a production path. Film axis/evidence types remain document-only; Stage 1b has no real provider; no lawful exact film plus human-recall pair is admitted; defaults are provisional and uncalibrated; and view has no HsmmResult/P/F lowering. Treat current posterior values as model-relative, not calibrated probabilities. Priority order: (1) fresh V12 successor commit 36051f6 and non-rewriting supersession of blocked cand-1EE04B; (2) repair the provider-parser exact-input-checksum blocker, then run/report real provider coverage and abstention; (3) obtain B0 owner dispositions or use a clearly synthetic/public-domain mechanical court; (4) implement C1 axis/evidence then decoder-free adapter/seam migration; (5) first exact film+recall P/F court; (6) static self-contained HTML/CSS uncertainty visualization; (7) pre-registered held-out calibration, baselines, and modality ablations. Parallel now: V12 recovery, reference-scope tool repair, frozen calibration court, output S1-S4, and recall-alignment view acceptance. C1 code still waits for P1+B0.
